cloudshots.title: CloudShots: Screenshot History
cloudshots.desc: CloudShots turns every screenshot on iPhone, iPad and Mac into a searchable history. On-device text recognition finds any screenshot by the words inside it, iCloud keeps the library in sync across devices with no account and no server, and a Mac menu bar panel captures and shares in one click. Built with SwiftUI, CloudKit, Vision and Apple Intelligence, localized into 13 languages.

marcus.title: Marcus: Second Brain
marcus.desc: A remote MCP memory server that lets Claude, ChatGPT and Perplexity save, search and recall notes that live only in the user's own private GitHub repository, never on Marcus's servers. Open source so anyone can verify that claim by reading the code. Built as a Cloudflare Worker with a full OAuth and vault-provisioning flow.

claudestatusline.title: Claude Code Plan Usage Statusline
claudestatusline.desc: A status line for Claude Code that reads the real server-side rate-limit data straight from the CLI's own stdin, not a local token estimate, and shows model, context, 5-hour and weekly plan headroom, git state, active goals and loops. Ships with a Stop hook that keeps the fallback cache fresh with zero extra permission prompts. Written in Ruby, 8+ stars on GitHub.

nostress.title: NoStress: Stress Tracker
nostress.desc: NoStress reads heart rate variability from Apple Watch and Fitbit to show your stress level in real time, on the wrist and on the phone. It sends gentle check-in notifications when your body needs a pause, and turns HRV, resting heart rate, sleep and activity into a daily overview and monthly trends. Built with SwiftUI, HealthKit, WatchKit and WidgetKit.

currency.title: Currency Converter: Best
currency.desc: A fast currency converter with live and offline exchange rates for 150+ currencies, a home screen widget, conversion history and a built-in calculator. Rates come from free public sources and are cached for travel without internet. Built with SwiftUI and WidgetKit.

usageguard.title: Claude Usage Guard
usageguard.desc: A plan-usage guardrail for Claude Code that stands a long-running session down before it hits its rate limit, checkpoints the task and goal, and wakes itself with a one-shot cron when the window resets. Built from Claude Code's own primitives: a Stop hook, a skill and a cron. It fails open, so a missing cache never blocks work.

usagebattery.title: Usage Battery for Claude Code
usagebattery.desc: A macOS menu bar app that shows Claude Code subscription usage as a battery: the current 5-hour session, the weekly limit and extra usage, with reset times. It reads the token Claude Code already stores in the Keychain and talks only to Anthropic, so no data is collected. Built with SwiftUI for macOS.

pixero.title: Image Editor: Pixero
pixero.desc: Pixero is a private, on-device photo editor: remove backgrounds, scan documents and apply quick edits without uploading a single photo. Everything runs locally with Vision and Core Image and exports to Photos, Files or the share sheet in JPEG, PNG or HEIC. Built with SwiftUI.

mathpanda.title: Math Panda - Learning Games for Kids
mathpanda.desc: Math Panda is an iOS app that makes mental math fun for kids and adults. It features visual hints, a friendly AI-powered panda tutor, and safe interactive quizzes. Practice and learn anytime with fun AI chat and smart math tasks.

sleeptrack.title: Snore Recorder: SleepTrack
sleeptrack.desc: SleepTrack records snoring and sleep talk overnight, plays the clips back in the morning with a simple sleep score, and wakes you with a smart alarm inside a gentle wake-up window. It also offers sleep sounds with a timer and 7-day trends. No account, no data collection: every recording, score and report stays on the iPhone. Built with SwiftUI and AVFoundation.

xchess.title: X-Chess & X-Checkers
xchess.desc: Led full-cycle development of a unified gaming platform for chess and checkers. Designed and implemented the client-server architecture for online play, AI bots (including Stockfish integration) and social features. Built matchmaking, ratings and gameplay customization. Set up CI/CD pipelines and analytics with automated event tracking and crash reporting.

ondoc.title: ONDOC
ondoc.desc: Led iOS development of a medical super-app with electronic medical records and telemedicine. As the lead iOS developer, I managed a team building new features in Objective-C, Swift, UIKit and SwiftUI. Launched and maintained over 30 white-label apps for medical institutions. Set up CI/CD pipelines with Fastlane, TeamCity and Xcode Cloud, improved app performance and resolved critical architectural issues.

mynovels.title: MyNovel: Novels & Stories
mynovels.desc: Led the development of MyNovel, a premium iOS reading platform built with Clean Swift architecture. As the technical lead, I managed the team that shipped the app. It launched with a scalable architecture.

tapcentive.title: Tapcentive - Tablet Smart Chip Gaming
tapcentive.desc: Led iOS development for an iPad-based gaming platform, working with a team of engineers, designers and marketers. Integrated NFC technology and Smart Chip Cards for a secure, portable gaming solution. The application is distributed through Apple Business Manager.

mathbrain.title: Math Brain - Arithmetic Learning Games Quiz
mathbrain.desc: Designed and developed an educational app that turns math learning into a daily challenge. Daily exercises train arithmetic, mental agility and cognitive speed, covering the fundamental operations.

twin.title: Twin - Pair Match Symbol Cards
twin.desc: Created a memory-matching game with smooth animations that tests focus and reaction time.

wordix.title: Wordix: Memorize word Game
wordix.desc: Developed a memory training app that applies neuroscience principles. Wordix offers daily exercises for memory retention, attention span and logical reasoning.

katalyst.title: Katalyst
katalyst.desc: Built a POS and Cloud Operating System. The platform combines point-of-sale functionality with cloud-based management tools.

tarot.title: Tarot
tarot.desc: Developed a tarot reading app with fluid animations. It includes card interpretations, interactive readings and a collection of tarot material.

autorent.title: AUTO.rent
autorent.desc: Developed a peer-to-peer car rental platform that connects vehicle owners with renters. The app features secure payment processing, real-time availability tracking and a review system.

tipntrip.title: tip n trip
tipntrip.desc: Created a travel companion app that helps users document and share their trips. The platform combines social features with practical travel tools for creating, organizing and sharing travel memories.

solo.title: SOLO
solo.desc: Developed an international calling app for voice calls across borders. It features competitive rates and clear audio quality.

forwardhorse.title: FORWARDHORSE
forwardhorse.desc: Developed a betting game that visualizes real-time exchange rates as racing horses. The app combines financial data with gameplay so users can track and predict market movements.

gasstationmap.title: GAS STATIONS MAP
gasstationmap.desc: Created a navigation app that helps users find nearby gas stations, compare fuel prices and read user reviews. It features real-time updates, detailed station information and a map interface.

promed.title: PROMED
promed.desc: Developed a healthcare platform connecting patients with medical professionals. The app supports remote consultations, appointment scheduling and access to a network of verified healthcare providers.

starway.title: STARWAY
starway.desc: Developed a horoscope app with personalized astrological readings and predictions. It features birth chart analysis, daily horoscopes and compatibility matching.

needaderm.title: NEED A DERM
needaderm.desc: Created a telemedicine platform specializing in dermatological consultations. The app enables secure image sharing, virtual appointments, and expert medical advice, making dermatological care more accessible.

readyforsky.title: READY FOR SKY
readyforsky.desc: Led the development of a smart home management system for Ready For Sky (R4S). As the lead developer, I coordinated the team, implemented new modules and improved the system architecture. The project used Agile/Scrum and GitFlow, with extensive documentation. Developed under OOO "Tekhnopoisk"/ OOO "Erlab" (REDMOND, Ready For Sky), the system offers home automation capabilities.

zonesdating.title: ZONES
zonesdating.desc: Developed a dating platform that combines social networking with interactive gaming elements. The app features user interactions, matching algorithms and a community.

wantticket.title: WANT TICKET
wantticket.desc: Built a peer-to-peer ticket marketplace for ticket resale. The platform features real-time availability and secure transactions.

socketsmap.title: SOCKETS MAP
socketsmap.desc: Created a community-driven platform that helps users locate and share information about public charging stations. The app features real-time availability updates, user reviews, and detailed location information.

weightanalyze.title: WEIGHT ANALYZE
weightanalyze.desc: Developed a health tracking app for monitoring and analyzing weight management. It features detailed analytics, progress tracking and personalized insights.

ninetydays.title: NINETY DAYS
ninetydays.desc: Built a habit app that helps users reach their goals through a structured 90-day program. It features progress tracking, milestone celebrations and personalized motivation tools.

vmeste.title: VMESTE
vmeste.desc: Developed a dating app with matching algorithms, mutual interest indicators and a chat system. Created for LTD. "Internet Agency LEGION" (ralegion.ru).

progressio.title: PROGRESSIO
progressio.desc: Created a goal-tracking app for monitoring and achieving objectives. It features progress analytics, customizable tracking metrics and visualization tools.

bileter.title: BILETER
bileter.desc: Developed a ticketing platform for cultural events, with interactive seat selection, secure payment processing and venue information. Created for LLC Internet agency LEGION (ralegion.ru), the app sells theater, concert and circus tickets.

cinemates.title: CINEMATES
cinemates.desc: Built a social movie-going platform for film fans. The app features movie recommendations, social scheduling and community tools. Developed for the Vkino/Cinemates service (vkino.ru, cinemates.com) under LLC Internet agency LEGION (ralegion.ru).

algeron.title: ALGERON
algeron.desc: Developed a patient management system for tracking health. The app features health logging, medication reminders and progress tracking. Created for LLC Internet agency LEGION (ralegion.ru).

fingerfeel.title: FINGER FEEL
fingerfeel.desc: Created a mood detection app that uses the front-facing camera to simulate fingerprint analysis. It was rejected by Apple for potential user confusion.

kookishcoffee.title: KOOKISH COFFEE
kookishcoffee.desc: Developed an informational app for Kookish Coffee with menu information, location details and special offers.
